description: OAuth operations: begin with site/base_url and optional app_entry; status or cancel with site; complete with site/state/code_vault_key/expected_version and optional set_default. OAuth app entry contains client_id, vault-referenced client_secret, registered redirect_uri and scopes including offline_access. Consent URL redirects to that registered URI; capture the authorization code agent-blind into a plugin oauth_code vault key, then complete with the returned state. No local callback server is created. Disconnect the local binding through sites; revoke the vendor grant through Atlassian account permissions.
embedding_description: Authorize a Jira Cloud site through Atlassian OAuth 2.0 three-legged consent, inspect or cancel pending consent, and complete the grant from a vaulted authorization code. State, expiry and accessible-site identity are verified; runtime access refresh persists rotating refresh tokens.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Site index/default/version, consent URL, or pending status. No tokens or client secrets.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the selected site and binding outcome. A consent URL means pending consent, not connected.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: stale_binding requires a fresh index version; oauth_state requires fresh consent; oauth_resources means the site is not granted; vault_error means persistence failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Read current site state, correct configuration, or restart consent as indicated. Never expose credentials.
